reason: I already have a crew in mind through friends, and all I want is the paperwork done. I can't see why I'd hand my flat to a list of strangers vetted by a process nobody has explained to me.
objection: Who checks that the crew is any good? The offer says the crews are checked, but it doesn't say how, and I'd still be paying them stage by stage on my own money.
would_change_my_mind: A clear, written description of how crews are checked, with real past jobs I can look up on Facebook, and a plain promise of what happens if the crew walks off mid-job.
